scope: Real product Session solo/host/guest, broker ordering, synthetic HUD settlement callbacks and profile persistence. Loopback and public transport are validated separately; not physical-phone QA.

results.name: entry accepts exactly one hero per player and rejects local or malformed rosters
received picks are checked before display, agree with spec and sanitize only valid data
old two-hero saves normalize selection while currency, purchases and history survive
all eight solo heroes cast, die, respawn and round-trip as a single hero
guest positions snap to approved slots and arbitrary legacy movement is rejected
host refuses foreign hero drops and nonfinite or old-coordinate movement
host background freezes time and input; lost foreground notification heals through full sync
guest background delays art-ready ACK; manual pause survives recovery
stalled snapshots gate guest commands until full hydration succeeds
permanent departure aborts without transferring heroes, structures or wallets
a direct sim leave aborts instead of making the other hero controllable
broker departure before finish rejects late victory; committed finish before departure remains
unconfirmed simulated result aborts; confirmed server results survive later peer-left
HUD interrupts an already-ended animation exactly once and never applies a result
finish waits for server acceptance, awards once, and cancels if departure wins the race
